hops.label: Sanction to disbursement
hops.hop_action: Pull the agency's payment register for this work. Confirm whether the balance is committed against an unpaid bill, unspent, or was returned. If unspent for more than one financial year, the sanction should be revalidated or surrendered rather than left standing.

hops.label: Disbursement to certification
hops.hop_action: Obtain the utilisation certificate from the implementing agency and match the certified amount and asset description against the sanction. If no UC exists for a disbursement older than 12 months, that is a recovery proceeding, not a query.

rule_hits.label: Description repeated under the same agency

citation.shared_description: led semi high mast light 6led with 200 watt 9 5 meter pole
citation.method: rapidfuzz.token_set_ratio over normalised description, blocked by agency_id
citation.reading: The descriptions in this cluster are identical after normalisation, so every component reads 1.0. This is exact repetition, not a fuzzy near-match. It is a cluster for review, not an accusation: 15 semi-high-mast LED lights under one district magistrate is very probably 15 street lights. Open the cited works and judge.

rule_hits.caveat: The duplicate_similarity threshold of 0.85 is not yet calibrated and fires on 61% of the corpus (DATA-PROFILE.md section 6). This rule's 18 points are provisional until Phase 7 chooses a scorer and a threshold together.

memo: Work WS/MP847/2025-2026/160261, 'Led Semi High Mast Light (6LED) with 200-watt, 9.5-meter pole', was sanctioned for Rs 1,99,539 on 17 November 2025 by DISTRICT MAGISTRATE JALAUN, on a recommendation made 333 days earlier on 19 December 2024. Rs 1,19,711 has been disbursed across 1 payment, 40.01% below the sanctioned amount, and no payment has been recorded in the 271 days since 26 November 2025. The same description appears on 15 works under this agency; two are cited above for comparison and should be opened before any conclusion is drawn, because repeated works of this kind are often legitimate. This agency carries 25 other HIGH cases in FY2025-2026. Execution time could not be assessed because no completion has been reported, and for the same reason the portal has published nothing about an asset photograph, so 30 of the 144 rulebook points could not be evaluated and this case is scored on 79% coverage. Score 92 of 100, HIGH, under rulebook v1.0.0. This memo is generated from a fixed template, not by a language model.
